section_summary.extract_value: The conclusion reports that the authors' final model fit well in a sample of college women and that body appreciation mediated links from interpersonal (e.g., restrictive/critical caregiver eating messages, attachment anxiety) and intrapersonal (e.g., discrepancy perfectionism) variables to intuitive eating. It also notes that body appreciation did not predict unique variance in depressive symptoms and recommends testing the model in more diverse samples.
section_summary.evidence_source: 'Our final model investigating interpersonal and intrapersonal links to body appreciation, as well as body appreciation's connection to intuitive eating, provided a good fit with college women.' 'Body appreciation played a central mediational role, as it accounted for links from interpersonal(i.e., restrictive/critical caregiver eating messages, attachment anxiety) and intrapersonal (i.e., discrepancy perfectionism) variables to intuitive eating...' 'Yet, body appreciation did not predict unique variance in depressive symptoms.'
